uncertainty: Nine bounded Packagist searches saved 205 hits and 151 distinct names. Twenty pinned third-party package paths passed valid local MP3 controls with ID3v2.3 or ID3v2.4 tags, meeting the numerical working goal. The paths span shared getID3, Mp3Info, PHP Reader, MediaInfoLib, FFmpeg, MetaAudio, and libsndfile parser families; wrappers and forks are identified in the parser records. MediaFile and its fork expose MP3 audio properties rather than tag text; all other included paths report ID3v2 text, with SoundFile also reporting MPEG Layer III properties. Pyrex requires an OLDXML compatibility shim for MediaInfo 26.10. Thirteen plausible leads remain unresolved, including a high-download TYPO3 extension whose local API has not been isolated, legacy PHP incompatibilities, a Composer-blocked dependency, and a missing source archive. Not all 151 hits were inspected, so this is not a definitive most-used top twenty. The controls establish short or 18-second tagged MP3s, not every MP3 or tag variant. PHP Fileinfo only identifies MIME type, and PECL id3 is not bundled. Packagist lifetime downloads rank only verified Composer paths within PHP and include unrelated format uses.
